engine.taskTimeout: Task timed out after {sec}s and was stopped.

engine.emptyResponse: Sorry, the AI returned nothing. Please try rephrasing
engine.emptyResponseReply: I drew a blank that time — try asking again in a different way?
engine.notUnderstood: Sorry, I didn't quite get that. Could you give me more detail?
engine.notUnderstoodTruncatedReply: My reply got too long and was cut off — try a simpler phrasing?
engine.notUnderstoodReply: I'm not sure what you'd like me to do — could you elaborate?
engine.needMoreInfo: I need a bit more information to continue — please tell me more
engine.scanProblem: Ran into a problem scanning the page. Please try again
engine.planAllDone: All steps executed, moving to final review
engine.unknownAction: Sorry, I can't perform that action
engine.confirmError: Sorry, something went wrong while executing
engine.stepProblem: Sorry, the previous step hit a problem: {msg}
engine.consecutiveFailuresReply: {count} steps failed in a row, so I'm stopping here. Want to try a different approach?
engine.maxSteps: Reached the max number of steps ({count}); the task may be incomplete. Tell me what to do next?
engine.unexpected: Sorry, something went wrong during execution
engine.unexpectedReply: Something unexpected happened midway — give the instruction one more try
engine.unknownSlash: I didn't recognize that command. Try /help to see what's available
engine.clearChatDone: Chat history cleared! Tell me whenever you need something new ✨
engine.resetDone: All context cleared — we can start fresh now~
engine.noGroups: There are no tab groups right now
engine.invalidTimeRange: That time range isn't valid. Use today / yesterday / week / month / all, e.g. /clear-history week
engine.noTabMatch: No tabs matched "{keyword}". Try a different keyword?
engine.swNoResponse: Sorry, the Service Worker is not responding right now

engine.submitSlashError: Sorry, something went wrong while handling the command
engine.submitSlashErrorReply: I couldn't process that command — try a different syntax or run it again?
engine.submitError: Sorry, something went wrong while handling your request
engine.submitErrorReply: I couldn't catch that request — tell me more about what you need?
engine.restoreDesc: Your last task was still in progress. Continue?
engine.restoreDone: Restored the context of your last task. Tell me what you'd like to continue with.

step.scriptNull: Script returned: null (usually means no element matched)

close_duplicate_tabs.desc: Close all duplicate tabs (keep the first of each group)

find_tab.desc: Find tabs by keyword (matches title / URL)

close_tabs_by_url.desc: Close tabs matching a URL substring or keyword (with checkboxes)

add_bookmark.desc: Add a bookmark. No args = current page; https://xxx = that URL; "title URL" separated by a space; github.com auto-adds https://

reopen_closed_tab.desc: Reopen the most recently closed tab (optionally filtered by title/URL keyword)

sort_tabs.desc: Sort tabs in the current window. No args = by domain; title = by title

search_history.desc: Browsing history. No args = all of today; with keyword = filtered

duplicate_tab.desc: Duplicate the current tab (keeps URL/title, inserted to the right)

screenshot.desc: Capture a screenshot: /screenshot [full{'|'}area{'|'}visible], visible by default

new_window.desc: Open a URL in a new window (no args = blank window)

list_groups.desc: List all tab groups in the current window

ungroup_all.desc: Remove all tab groups at once (tabs are kept)

group_by_domain.desc: Auto-group tabs by domain (pinned tabs excluded)

get_cookies.desc: View cookies. No args = current site domain; with domain = that domain (table view)

clear_cookies.desc: Clear cookies. No args = current site domain; with domain = that domain (dangerous, asks for confirmation)

list_extensions.desc: View all installed extensions (optionally filtered by keyword)

enable_extension.desc: Enable an extension (by name or ID)

disable_extension.desc: Disable an extension (by name or ID)

uninstall_extension.desc: Uninstall an extension (dangerous, asks for confirmation)

get_site_permissions.desc: View site permissions (popups/notifications/JS etc.). No args = current site domain

set_site_permission.desc: Set a site permission. Example: /set-site-perm github.com popups block

storage_get.desc: Read extension local storage. No args = list all; with key = single value (table view)

storage_set.desc: Write extension local storage. Example: /storage-set myKey myValue

storage_remove.desc: Delete an extension local storage key

stop_recording.desc: Stop recording and save the video

reset_context.desc: Clear all context and start a fresh conversation
